_note: GLM-4.7-Flash 30B-A3B. Per the model card, serve with --tool-call-parser glm47 --reasoning-parser glm45 --enable-auto-tool-choice. UNLIKE Qwen, GLM keeps the reasoning parser ON -- its template separates reasoning from the tool call, so glm47 still extracts tool calls from content. NO --language-model-only (GLM is text-only). Speculative decoding (mtp, 1 token) per card. Serving with qwen3_coder instead would drop GLM tool calls -> zeroed eval (memory: vllm-tool-parser-gotcha).
_note_mla: GLM-4.x MoE uses MLA (Multi-head Latent Attention, like DeepSeek-V2). The mi300 backend (harbor_eval.sbatch ROCM_SERVE_EXTRA) defaults to --attention-backend ROCM_AITER_FA + --kv-cache-dtype fp8, which are for DENSE attention and reject MLA ('MLA not supported', 'head_size not supported'). extra_args below OVERRIDE both (vLLM appends VLLM_EXTRA_ARGS last, argparse last-wins): TRITON_MLA is the MLA backend this build auto-selects when AITER-MLA isn't enabled, and kv-cache-dtype auto avoids the fp8+MLA path. To try the faster AITER MLA instead, set env VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MLA=1 and use ROCM_AITER_MLA.
_note_context: Served window (max_model_len) is 131072; native max_position_embeddings is 202752 (no RoPE scaling). 131072 is a deliberate cap. GLM's MLA keeps per-token KV cache small, so raising toward native is comparatively cheap on VRAM.
